assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a square transparent-background reward illustration for a children's chores app. Image 1 is the subject reference: redraw just its tabletop toy claw machine as a generic unbranded claw game, NOT its retail box or shop photo. Image 2 is a style reference only. One centered complete machine, front three-quarter view, fills about 88% of the frame, clean silhouette, clearly visible hanging three-prong claw in the upper glass chamber, a few cute plush prizes below it, joystick and two chunky buttons on the front control deck, accessible prize chute on the bottom front. Keep the machinery plausible and readable at small mobile size. Polished dimensional toy illustration, soft studio light, crisp edges, delightful rounded shapes. Transparent alpha background, including the empty space around the machine; no floor, environment, packaging, writing, logo, price label, watermark, or Pokemon branding. Teenieping style: glossy candy-colored toy rendering matching image 2. Pink, lavender, turquoise and yellow accents, heart and star emblems. A few tiny big-eyed Teenieping fairy plush prizes inside, and a small heart-shaped ornament above the canopy. The claw machine is the sole main subject; no character standing outside it.
